  • Produce one Markdown transcript per session.

  • Use the filename format <timestamp>_<session-id>.md.

  • Include YAML frontmatter with session metadata, Git author, Git email, GitHub username, and relevant statistics.

4. Verify the application environment

Inspect the existing onboarding scripts and relevant documentation.

Check whether:

  • Dependencies are installed.

  • Node.js and pnpm are available.

  • The application can be started using the documented commands.

  • Local environment files are present, without disclosing secrets.

  • Existing Git hooks and repository checks are configured.

Use read-only checks wherever possible.

Do not reinstall dependencies, run migrations, start unnecessary services, or modify application files.

5. Identify minimum required changes

A. Already working — leave unchanged

B. Missing or broken — needs correction

Solutions verified under the real contract:

  • Each problem has a straightforward and an optimized correct solution, plus 3 to 5 wrong beginner ones. The new test runs 20 correct and 32 wrong ones, so it is not vacuous.
